test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Two right-angled triangles are congruent when which of the following conditions is true?

options.text: When only one of the sides of one of these triangles is equal in length to the corresponding side of the other triangle
When one more angle is equal
When their hypotenuses are equal and one of the sides of one of these triangles is equal in length to the corresponding side of the other triangle
When only their hypotenuses are equal

solution:
**Concept used**

Congruence of triangles: Two triangles are said to be congruent if their all sides and angles are equal corresponding to the other triangle’s all sides and angles. <span style="color: rgb(30, 43, 51); font-weight: 700; user-select: text !important; pointer-events: initial !important;&quo
